scenes.title: Following the Hidden Route
scenes.rationale: Choosing the concealed approach and following the numbered stones share one immediate goal: finding the dwarven entrance. Entering the gorge and leaving the horses marks the shift to underground exploration.

scenes.title: Through Water and Illusion
scenes.rationale: Draining the flooded tunnel and navigating the guard chamber, ladder, and false cave-in form a continuous exploration of the concealed entrance route. Opening the final door introduces an inhabited cavern and a new social situation.

scenes.title: The Price of Passage
scenes.rationale: The bargain with Inakara continues as she leads the party to the marketplace and explains the threat. Keep her demand, guidance, and the party’s preparations together; the first tentacle attack begins the fight.

scenes.title: The Roper in the Marketplace
scenes.rationale: The ambush, escapes, discovery of the roper’s limited mobility, and burning-arrow tactic are phases of one uninterrupted fight. Its brief aftermath resolves the bargain only as far as Inakara pointing out the onward door.
